outcome.reasoning: Poisson model: expected goals Manchester United FC 1.56 vs Brentford FC 2.33, from each side's season scoring and conceding rates at this venue.
evidence: Manchester United FC at home: 1W-2D-2L, 10 scored and 11 conceded in 5 games.
Brentford FC away: 0W-4D-1L, 6 scored and 8 conceded in 5 games.
League averages this season: home teams 1.58 goals per game, away teams 1.17.
Recent league form (newest first): Manchester United FC LDLLD, Brentford FC WLWDL (shown for context, not used by the model).
uncertainties: Statistical model only: it ignores injuries, suspensions, lineups, tactics, motivation, fixture congestion and weather.
Small sample: Manchester United FC has 5 home games and Brentford FC 5 away games this season, so venue-specific rates are noisy (they are blended with overall strength).
Simple Poisson models tend to slightly underestimate draws.
